claims.text: The Bombay Gazetteer describes Bajirav’s restoration at Poona in exchange for a permanent force and assigned revenues. Hyderabad’s compiled agreement puts Company troops in the Nizam’s pay but forbids stationing them to collect revenue. Funding a force does not grant identical revenue employment or establish uniform direct rule or consent.
